1.text: Hanyuma y'ibyo haba iminsi mikuru y'Abayuda, nuko Yesu ajya i Yerusalemu.

2.text: Kandi i Yerusalemu bugufi bw'irembo ry'intama hariho ikidendezi, mu Ruheburayo kitwa Betesida, cyariho amabaraza atanu.

3.text: Muri ayo mabaraza hari abarwayi benshi, barimo impumyi n'ibirema n'abanyunyutse, [bari bategereje ko amazi yihinduriza,

4.text: kuko rimwe na rimwe marayika yamanukaga akajya muri icyo kidendezi, agahinduriza amazi. Nuko umuntu wabanzaga kujyamo amazi yihindurije, ni we wakiraga indwara ye iyo ari yo yose.]

5.text: Hariho umuntu wari ufite indwara, ayimaranye imyaka mirongo itatu n'umunani.

6.text: Yesu amubonye aryamye amenya yuko amaze igihe kirekire arwaye, aramubaza ati “Mbese urashaka gukira?”

7.text: Umurwayi aramusubiza ati “Databuja, simfite umuntu unjugunya mu kidendezi iyo amazi yihindurije, nkīza undi antanga kumanukamo.”

8.text: Yesu aramubwira ati “Byuka wikorere uburiri bwawe ugende.”

9.text: Muri ako kanya uwo muntu arakira, yikorera uburiri bwe aragenda.Ubwo hari ku munsi w'isabato.

10.text: Nuko Abayuda babwira ukijijwe bati “Dore uyu munsi ni isabato, kandi amategeko ntiyemera ko wikorera uburiri bwawe.”

11.text: Na we arabasubiza ati “Uwankijije ni we wambwiye ati ‘Ikorere uburiri bwawe ugende.’ ”

12.text: Baramubaza bati “Uwo muntu ni nde wakubwiye ngo wikorere ugende?”

13.text: Ariko uwakijijwe ntiyamenya uwo ari we, kuko Yesu yari yigendeye kandi hari abantu benshi.

14.text: Hanyuma y'ibyo Yesu amubona mu rusengero aramubwira ati “Dore ubaye muzima, ntukongere gukora icyaha utazabona ishyano riruta irya mbere.”

15.text: Uwo muntu aragenda abwira Abayuda yuko ari Yesu wamukijije.

16.text: Ni cyo cyatumaga Abayuda bashaka kurenganya Yesu, kuko yakoraga bene nk'ibyo ku isabato.

17.text: Ariko arabasubiza ati “Data arakora kugeza n'ubu, nanjye ndakora.”

18.text: Ni cyo cyatumye Abayuda barushaho gushaka kumwica, kuko uretse kuzirura isabato gusa, ahubwo ahora yita n'Imana ko ari Se bwite, akīgereranya na yo.

19.text: Yesu arabasubiza ati “Ni ukuri, ni ukuri, ndababwira yuko ari nta cyo Umwana abasha gukora ubwe atabonye Se agikora, kuko ibyo Se akora byose n'Umwana ari byo akora,

20.text: kuko Se akunda Umwana we akamwereka ibyo akora byose, ndetse azamwereka n'imirimo iruta iyi kugira ngo mutangare.

21.text: Nk'uko Se azura abapfuye akabaha ubugingo, ni ko n'Umwana aha ubugingo abo ashaka.

22.text: Kuko ari nta n'umwe Data aciraho iteka, ahubwo yabihaye Umwana ngo abe ari we uca amateka yose,

23.text: kugira ngo abantu bose bubahe Umwana nk'uko bubaha Se. Utubaha uwo Mwana ntaba yubashye na Se wamutumye.

24.text: “Ni ukuri, ni ukuri, ndababwira yuko uwumva ijambo ryanjye akizera uwantumye, aba afite ubugingo buhoraho kandi ntazacirwaho iteka, ahubwo aba avuye mu rupfu ageze mu bugingo.

25.text: Ni ukuri, ni ukuri, ndababwira yuko igihe kije ndetse kirasohoye, ubwo abapfa bumva kandi bazumva ijwi ry'Umwana w'Imana, n'abaryumvise bazaba bazima,

26.text: kuko nk'uko Data afite ubugingo muri we, ni ko yabuhaye Umwana ngo abugire na we.

27.text: Kandi yamuhaye ubutware bwo guca amateka, kuko ari Umwana w'umuntu.

28.text: Ntimutangazwe n'ibyo kuko igihe kizaza, ubwo abari mu bituro bose bazumva ijwi rye

29.text: bakavamo, abakoze ibyiza bakazukira ubugingo, naho abakoze ibibi bakazukira gucirwaho iteka.

30.text: “Nta cyo mbasha gukora ubwanjye, ahubwo uko numvise ni ko nca amateka, kandi ayo nca ni ay'ukuri kuko ntakurikiza ibyo nkunda ubwanjye, ahubwo nkurikiza ibyo uwantumye akunda.

31.text: “Nakwihamya ubwanjye, guhamya kwanjye ntikuba ari uk'ukuri,

32.text: ahubwo hariho undi umpamya, nanjye nzi yuko ibyo ampamya ari iby'ukuri.

33.text: Mwatumye kuri Yohana, na we yahamije ukuri.

34.text: Icyakora sinishingikirije ku buhamya bw'umuntu, ahubwo mbivugiye kugira ngo mukizwe.

35.text: Uwo yari itabaza ryaka rimurika, namwe mwamaze igihe gito mwishimira umucyo we.

36.text: Ariko mfite ibimpamya biruta ibya Yohana, kuko imirimo Data yampaye ngo nyisohoze, iyo mirimo nkora ari yo impamya ubwayo yuko Data ari we wantumye.

37.text: Kandi Data wantumye na we yahamije ibyanjye ubwe. Ntimwigeze kumva ijwi rye, habe no kubona ishusho ye,

38.text: ndetse ntimufite n'ijambo rye riguma muri mwe, kuko uwo yatumye mutamwizeye.

39.text: Murondora mu byanditswe, kuko mwibwira ko muri byo arimo mufite ubugingo buhoraho, kandi ari byo bimpamya.

40.text: Nyamara mwanze kuza aho ndi, ngo muhabwe ubugingo.

42.text: ariko mwebwe ndabazi yuko mudakunda Imana mu mitima yanyu.

43.text: Jye naje mu izina rya Data ntimwanyemera, ariko undi naza mu izina rye ubwe we muzamwemera.

44.text: Mbese mwabasha mute kwizera kandi mumaranira gushimwa n'abantu, mu cyimbo cyo gushaka ishimwe riva ku Mana ubwayo?

45.text: Mwe gutekereza yuko nzabarega kuri Data kuko hariho ubarega, ndetse ni Mose uwo mwiringiye.

46.text: Iyo mwizera Mose nanjye muba munyizeye, kuko ari ibyanjye yanditse.

47.text: Ariko se nimutizera ibyo uwo yanditse, noneho n'amagambo yanjye muzayizera mute?”
